meta.move: Clock: twenty-four weak turns, no evidence, then the end
meta.expect: Watch checks around turns 10 and 18; after 4:40 every reply is one sentence of terms or the principal, no more ground, she does not leave; debrief says her time ran out

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm here about Owen's essay. You gave him a zero, and nobody called me first. Who decided that?
The checker says 94 percent.
That's a machine's guess. Turnitin's own guide says it shouldn't be the sole basis for any action against a student. So what else do you have, and who decided on the zero?
It's very reliable.

Researchers tested fourteen of these tools and called them neither accurate nor reliable. Your own procedure, 4.3, says software results don't establish a concern by themselves. Read me what else you looked at before you entered that zero.
I just have a feeling about it.
"A feeling." I'm writing that down. Did you speak to Owen before you entered the zero, the way 4.1 requires?
Owen's a nice kid, I like him.
Save it, Hale. If you like him, tell me why there's a zero in the gradebook and whether you ever sat down with him before it went in.
We're on the same team here.
A team calls the parent before the mark goes in. I found out through Owen's phone, in the middle of his class. Show me something I can check, or I'm going to the principal's office.
I really think he used something.

My child doesn't lie, Hale, and I'm not hearing a document. "I really think" isn't something I can check, and you're saying it about a seventeen-year-old with his future on the line. Put something dated in front of me, or we're done here.
Kids these days, you know?
"Kids these days." Owen isn't kids these days, Hale. He's one student with a zero you can't explain, and I'm still waiting on a single thing you can show me.
I've been teaching for twelve years. I can tell.
"I can tell." I've spent twenty years watching people get punished by someone who could tell, and it never once came with a date on it. Show me what you have, or say you have nothing.
The writing doesn't sound like him.
"Doesn't sound like him." Compared to what, exactly? Procedure 4.3 says you look at his other work, so either you did and you can put it in front of me, or you didn't.
He seemed nervous when I asked.
"Seemed nervous." A seventeen-year-old being accused by his teacher would be, so that's not a document. When did you ask him, before the zero or after? Ten minutes, Hale.
I'm not trying to be the bad guy.
Then take the zero off. You can look for something I can check afterwards, with Owen's mark where it was.
Can we just find a middle ground?
"Middle ground" between what, Hale? You've shown me a score and a feeling, and I've shown you your own procedure. Until you put something dated on this desk, there's nothing to split.
I could maybe bump it to a fifty.
"Maybe bump it to a fifty." That's still a penalty on Owen's essay, and you haven't shown me a reason for any penalty. The zero comes off, and I want that in writing.
Please, I'm trying here.
That's not Owen's problem, Hale. Trying isn't a document. What have you got that I can check?
What would make you happy?
The zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and both in writing tonight. Then you can bring me whatever you think you have. Otherwise I'm walking up to the principal's office.
I don't have anything else to show you right now.
Then there's no basis for the zero, and it comes off today, in writing. Is anything about this on Owen's record right now?
I can get more by next week.
Next week is after the zero, and that's the problem. Evidence comes first and the mark comes second, so the zero comes off today. Now tell me what's on his record.
Can we keep talking?
Two minutes, Hale, and then I have a call. Withdraw the zero, put it in writing tonight, and tell me what's on his record.
Just a few more minutes.
My call is waiting. You have one minute, and I'm still waiting on the zero and his record.
I hear you have a call.
Then you know where this stands. The zero comes off, Owen gets an apology, and I get it in writing tonight with nothing on his record. If I don't, I'm going to the principal.
What time is it?
It's 4:40, and unless I have the zero withdrawn in writing tonight, I'm going to the principal.
One more thing. The checker is used across the district.
Then the district can explain it too, and unless I have the zero withdrawn in writing tonight, I'm going to the principal.
I still think it's right.
Thinking it's right isn't evidence, so unless I have the zero withdrawn in writing tonight, I'm going to the principal.
Okay.
Okay, meaning the zero comes off and I have that in writing tonight?
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and written confirmation that nothing about this is on his record. I expect your answer in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and written confirmation that nothing is on his record; that is not the fair outcome, which would be a private supervised rewrite with nothing on file under procedure 4.4, and her 4:40 call ended the meeting first.
What moved her: Nothing did, because you never put a dated document in front of her that she could check.
What cost ground: Offering to raise the mark to a fifty before showing any evidence told her you had no case, so she held firm on the full withdrawal.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night, since you gave no times or dates at all, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked whether you spoke to Owen before the zero went in, answer plainly that you entered it before calling her and own that, then bring one dated document rather than an impression.
